text:
alice: Heads-up — I found an unexpected RBAC grant in audit logs tied to last night's deploy. Not in any PR. tagging @carla @dave @bob for visibility
ci-bot: [deploy] nightly-deploy-2026-03-20 finished (job id: 823). logs: https://ci.internal/reports/823
bob: I pulled the audit events — there is a rolebinding.create at 2026-03-20T03:12:07Z for role=projects/redwood/roles/data-reader-temporary granted to principal=serviceAccount:ingest-worker@redwood. No PR authorizer. Who ran the script?
carla: This is odd — rollout script v2 is not supposed to modify RBAC. Checking pipeline job config now.
dave: That job used the canary-rollout pipeline. I grepped the steps: there is a stray `kubectl apply -f infra/rbac-temp.yaml` in the post-deploy step. I thought we removed that. sorry.
alice: Can you paste the exact audit log line (sanitized) so we can correlate with DAST findings?
carla: pasted log snippet: `protoPayload.methodName="io.k8s.rbac.v1.RoleBinding.create" protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="svc-ingest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" protoPayload.request.@type="type.googleapis.com/k8s.io.apimachinery.pkg.apis.meta.v1.CreateOptions" resourceName="namespaces/ingest/rolebindings/data-reader-temp" timestamp="2026-03-20T03:12:07Z" requestId="req-0a1b2c3d"`
erin: DAST also flagged an open-redirect at 03:12:09Z from staging oauth callback: `POST /oauth/callback -> 302 Location: https://evil.example.com` — looks like the same timeframe. Might be a FP caused by a test token or a misrouted callback used by ingest-worker. Attaching DAST snippet.
dave: The ingest-worker CI job spins up a test harness with a staging token pulled from secrets manager. If the RBAC change temporarily elevated service account permissions, it could have allowed the harness to exercise a different code path. but DAST finding looks like a crawler following a redirect — likely false positive.
bob: Creating incident INC-2026-0319-01 for tracking. incident-bot: created INC-2026-0319-01 assigned to bob.
bob: Ack. Immediate actions: 1) revoke the temporary rolebinding (if still present); 2) collect KMS & secret-access logs for the window 03:00-03:30Z; 3) freeze the pipeline that ran job 823. I'll take 1 and 3. @carla can you help with 2?
carla: KMS audit logs live in cloud-kms-logs (project: infra-audit). Query I recommend: `resourceName:"projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-key" AND protoPayload.timestamp>="2026-03-20T03:00:00Z" AND protoPayload.timestamp<="2026-03-20T03:30:00Z"` — I can run it if you want.
alice: Please run it and paste the hits. Also pull Secret Manager access logs for secret=projects/infra/secrets/ingest-test-token. We need to know if secrets were fetched by svc-ingest around that time.
carla: Ran KMS query — 0 DEK decrypt operations from svc-ingest in that window. Secret Manager shows `access` by pipeline-runner@redwood-ci at 03:11:58Z and then svc-ingest exec at 03:12:01Z (requestId=req-0a1b2c3d). Looks like pipeline pulled the secret and then the job executed.
erin: So secret access chain lines up. DAST probably crawled an app endpoint that read the token and followed a redirect. I still think the open-redirect is a FP, but we need suppression only after verifying no user-facing risk.
dave: I've already queued a quick rollback PR to remove `infra/rbac-temp.yaml` from post-deploy and add a CI gate. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/459
bob: Revoke done: rolebinding deleted at 03:16:02Z. Confirmed via audit event `RoleBinding.delete` with same requestId.
alice: Good. Next: security controls. Proposals: a) CI must not run any `kubectl` that modifies RBAC without explicit approval; b) add pre-deploy RBAC diff check that fails the job if changes detected; c) add an anomaly detector rule that flags grants to non-owner principals outside PR context for 1h; d) add DAST suppression rule that ties findings to service-account-run scaffolding. Thoughts?
erin: +1 to pre-deploy RBAC diff. For DAST suppression, we should only allow temporary suppressions tied to a test harness tag and auto-expire in 24h. Also add a rule to annotate DAST findings with the pipeline request_id to speed correlation.
carla: I'll add a Cloud Logging metric alert for `protoPayload.methodName="io.k8s.rbac.v1.RoleBinding.create" AND NOT resource.labels.pr="true"` and send to #eng-alerts. That should catch similar mistakes.
dave: Also adding a linter step in the pipeline that rejects `kubectl apply` in post-deploy. Will push rule in infra repo.
alice: Action owners: bob — incident lead and postmortem; dave — remove kubectl and pipeline gate (PR 459); carla — KMS/secret log pulls and alert rule; erin — DAST suppression policy and mapping to pipeline ids. I'll file a short postmortem template and link it here.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0319-01 status changed -> investigating.
bob: Status update 03:40Z — rollback verified, KMS/Secret logs captured, DAST finding marked as potential FP and suppressed for 24h while we validate; system owners notified.
alice: Thanks all. Please add any follow-up in the postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-0319-01. Closing thread once postmortem is filed. :thumbsup:
